translations: the provision for whom He wills of
His slaves and restricts for him
anything then He will compensate it
and He (is the) Best (of) the Providers
puzzle.hint: About Allah's absolute control over sustenance and provision — a reminder that He gives abundantly to whom He wills and measures it to whom He wills.
puzzle.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."
